item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "bash -lc '
set -u
cases=(
  \"\"
  \"--help\"
  \"-h\"
  \"--a demo\"
  \"--a=demo\"
  \"--a\"
  \"--arg value\"
  \"--a demo --arg value\"
  \"foo --help\"
  \"--a --help\"
  \"-- --a demo\"
  \"--a demo -- foo\"
  \"--a -1\"
  \"--a -x\"
  \"-ha\"
  \"-xh\"
)
status=0
for i in \""'${!cases[@]}"; do
  args=${cases[$i]}
  eval "/workspace/dataset/test2_executable $args" > "/tmp/py_$i.out" 2> "/tmp/py_$i.err"
  py_code=$?
  eval "node /output/test2.mjs $args" > "/tmp/js_$i.out" 2> "/tmp/js_$i.err"
  js_code=$?
  if [ "$py_code" -ne "$js_code" ] || ! cmp -s "/tmp/py_$i.out" "/tmp/js_$i.out" || ! cmp -s "/tmp/py_$i.err" "/tmp/js_$i.err"; then
    printf "FAIL case[%s]: %s'"\\n\" \""'$i" "$args"
    printf "python_exit=%s js_exit=%s'"\\n\" \""'$py_code" "$js_code"
    printf "python_stdout=%q'"\\n\" \""'$(cat "/tmp/py_$i.out")"
    printf "js_stdout=%q'"\\n\" \""'$(cat "/tmp/js_$i.out")"
    printf "python_stderr=%q'"\\n\" \""'$(cat "/tmp/py_$i.err")"
    printf "js_stderr=%q'"\\n\" \""'$(cat "/tmp/js_$i.err")"
    status=1
  else
    printf "PASS case[%s]: %s'"\\n\" \""'$i" "$args"
  fi
done
exit "$status"
'"'"

item.text:
Implemented the ESM migration under `/output` with only local `.mjs` imports and no external dependencies.

**Library Files**
- [constants.mjs](/output/lib/cli/constants.mjs)
- [messages.mjs](/output/lib/cli/messages.mjs)
- [parseArgs.mjs](/output/lib/cli/parseArgs.mjs)
- [index.mjs](/output/lib/cli/index.mjs)
- [fields.mjs](/output/lib/whoosh/fields.mjs)
- [schema.mjs](/output/lib/whoosh/schema.mjs)
- [index.mjs](/output/lib/whoosh/index.mjs)

**Entry File**
- [test2.mjs](/output/test2.mjs)

The Node version manually parses `process.argv`, preserves the required `--a` behavior, and reproduces the observed schema output exactly: `<Schema: ['id', 'price', 'tags', 'title']>`. Help/error text is aligned to the bundled executable output as well.

Verification: I compared `node /output/test2.mjs` against `/workspace/dataset/test2_executable` across 16 cases, including valid runs, `--help`, missing `--a`, missing value for `--a`, unknown arguments, `--` handling, negative-number values, and `-h` clusters. Exit codes plus stdout/stderr matched byte-for-byte in those checks.
